summary: squeez@1.44.1: postinstall fetches remote content from raw.githubusercontent.com with platform-branched execution
details: package.json declares a postinstall hook ("postinstall": "node install.js") that fires automatically on npm install. install.js pulls in child_process, https, fs, and os, branches on process.platform, reads os.homedir() and process.env, and issues https.get() calls against raw.githubusercontent.com (referenced at lines 76 and 104). The combination of an install-time lifecycle script, platform-detection branching, home-directory and environment reads, and fetches from a mutable third-party content host that are then handled together with child_process is consistent with the install-time fetch-and-execute pattern used by dropper-shaped packages. Raw GitHub content URLs are author-mutable and are not a pinned, verified release artifact.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
